text.p: BOGOTA, April 9 Reuter - ING Barings said it had downgraded both common and preferred ADRs of Colombia's Banco Ganadero from a buy to hold following solid performances over the past year.

Reasons cited by analysts at the New York-based investment bank included the likelihood of "limited returns of 12 percent and 16 percent until December 1997" and the possibility of lower than expected first quarter results.
Analysts also cited delays in announcements of new acquisitions by Ganadero or of strategic plans to enter into Colombia's savings and loans business.

Furthermore, an expected drop in Colombia's domestic lending rates later this year, due to increasing competition in the banking sector, could contribute to a decline in Ganadero's profit margins, ING Barings said.
It added that growth in credit volumes and fee income should partly compensate for the decline in margins, however.
